Call for Scores
2027/28

Your application is in.

Thank you. Both scores arrived and nothing else is needed from you.

What happens now

The call closes on 15 December 2026. After that the first round is read blind: the jury does not know whose work is whose. It is read by the musicians of the ensemble, the people who would have to play the piece, together with composers chosen in earlier cycles of this call.

When you will hear

By spring 2027, whatever the answer is. Everyone who applies hears from us. Reading everything properly, twice, around a season of concerts and tours is slow work, and we would rather be slow than skim.

If something went wrong

If you think a file did not upload, or you need to correct something, write to info@creartbox.nyc and say which call you applied to. We would rather fix it now than find it in January.
